description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Developer Experience team builds the backend systems and product capabilities that help developers understand, secure and ship software with confidence. The team powers important parts of Docker Scout, Docker Hardened Images and the workflows that turn supply-chain data into useful developer experiences.

Our systems are deliberately polyglot. Today that includes Clojure and Go services, event-driven workflows, Kafka, legacy Datomic components and newer Spanner-backed services. We will keep evolving the stack as the product and business change. We are looking for an adaptable backend engineer who can become effective in an unfamiliar codebase, choose technology pragmatically and help other engineers do the same. Clojure experience is useful, but it is not a requirement and this is not a Clojure-specialist role.

We make extensive use of AI-assisted engineering tools. We expect engineers to use them thoughtfully, validate their output and remain accountable for the quality, security and operability of what ships. At Staff level, you will also help the team turn good individual practice into repeatable workflows, controls and shared standards.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead ambiguous, cross-team work from problem definition through measurable outcomes. You will remain hands-on in code while shaping architecture, raising operational standards and creating enough clarity for several engineers and partner teams to move quickly. Work may span developer-facing features, build and artefact workflows, data and event pipelines, platform evolution and integrations with Docker's build and security systems.

Success in This Role Looks Like

You will succeed by finding the highest-leverage problem, creating momentum before every detail is known and bringing people with you. Within your first year, teams should be delivering more confidently because you have made system boundaries clearer, reduced operational risk, connected technical choices to customer outcomes and helped senior engineers take on larger work.

Responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for major backend and developer-experience initiatives across Clojure, Go and adjacent systems.

  • Turn ambiguous product or platform problems into clear plans, staged decisions and measurable outcomes.

  • Design, build and operate distributed services, event pipelines, databases and APIs with strong security and reliability characteristics.

  • Lead cross-team delivery, surface risks early and remove technical or organisational blockers without waiting for formal authority.

  • Make pragmatic recommendations about when to retain, evolve or replace existing components, including the continued reduction of legacy Datomic dependencies.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Security and other engineering teams to connect technical investment to developer and business outcomes.

  • Improve observability, incident readiness, performance and service ownership across the Developer Experience estate.

  • Improve engineering leverage through appropriate automation, AI-assisted workflows and controls that preserve human accountability.

  • Mentor senior engineers, raise the quality of design and code reviews and create reusable patterns that multiply the team.

  • Stay hands-on through implementation, debugging and the team's paid on-call rotation.

  • Communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly in a remote, async-first environment.

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems at scale.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Deep experience designing, building and operating production backend or platform systems.

  • Strong programming ability in at least one production language, with evidence of becoming effective in unfamiliar languages and codebases.

  • Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, APIs, relational or distributed databases and cloud-native infrastructure.

  • A track record of leading complex initiatives that crossed team or organisational boundaries.

  • Strong technical and product judgement, including the ability to explain constraints, alternatives, customer outcomes and business trade-offs.

  • Evidence of influencing without authority and improving the effectiveness of other experienced engineers.

  • An operational mindset that treats observability, resilience, incident response and on-call ownership as part of engineering.

  • Comfort using AI-assisted engineering tools critically while retaining ownership of the result.

  • Clear written and spoken communication suited to a remote, async-first company.

Helpful, but not required

  • Production experience with Go, Clojure or both.

  • Experience with Spanner, Datomic, Kafka or other distributed data and streaming platforms.

  • Experience with build systems, containers, artefact workflows or developer tooling.

  • Experience evolving a platform, database or language strategy without disrupting product delivery.

  • Experience building security or software supply-chain products.

What to Expect

First 30 Days

  • Build context on Developer Experience products, customers, architecture and current priorities.

  • Pair across Clojure, Go, Datomic and Spanner-backed systems and ship a useful production change.

  • Understand the operational profile of the team's services, including on-call and recurring failure modes.

  • Build working relationships with Product, Design, Security and adjacent engineering teams.

  • Learn the team's AI-assisted engineering practices and identify where shared controls or workflows would improve them.

First 90 Days

  • Lead the technical framing and delivery plan for one significant team or cross-team problem.

  • Contribute production code in the parts of the stack needed to move that work forward.

  • Identify and begin addressing a material reliability, observability, data or architectural weakness.

  • Establish a mentoring and design-review cadence that helps other engineers own larger decisions.

One Year Outlook (First Year)

  • Be a trusted technical leader for Developer Experience and a sought-after partner across Docker.

  • Deliver at least one material product or platform outcome spanning multiple teams or systems.

  • Improve the reliability, clarity and delivery speed of the backend and data estate.

  • Shape pragmatic evolution across Clojure, Go, Datomic, Spanner and future technologies without turning technology choice into the goal.

  • Grow other senior engineers into broader ownership and reduce the number of decisions that depend on a small set of people.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Credit
description:
LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.


Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.


With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

About the role

LemFi's Credit tribe is early and moving fast. We're building the infrastructure that will power lending products for millions of people who've historically been locked out of fair credit - immigrants, diaspora communities, and the financially underserved across our 21 operating markets. This is a ground-floor opportunity: the tribe is being built right now, and the systems you design today will be the foundation everything else sits on.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Credit tribe and own core backend services end-to-end. You'll be working primarily in Go, with some existing Java services in the mix - switching between them is not the blocker, deep engineering craft and an instinct for how credit products behave is. We move fast and we don't micromanage, which means you'll need to bring the domain awareness to make the right call before anyone has to tell you.

What you'll build and own

  • Design, build and operate high-reliability backend services that power LemFi's credit products, from loan origination and underwriting through to repayment and collections.

  • Make the right architectural calls independently - data residency, service boundaries, state-machine design for loan lifecycles - without needing to be told what a credit-safe system looks like.

  • Own your services in production: instrument them, monitor them, debug them, and hold the bar on reliability and correctness.

  • Work closely with product and compliance to translate credit-domain requirements into clean, testable, maintainable code.

  • Use AI coding tools actively to accelerate delivery and improve test coverage, while taking full ownership of the correctness of every line that ships.

  • Contribute to growing the tribe - as one of the earliest engineers you'll help set the engineering culture, review others' work, and raise the bar on how we build.

Your experience

  • Strong backend engineering in Go; Java experience is a plus given our existing services, but Go is the primary language.

  • Meaningful fintech experience - you understand how financial systems behave under load, under regulation, and under audit.

  • Exposure to credit products (lending, underwriting, repayment, collections) at any level - even adjacent - so you arrive with the right instincts, not just a willingness to learn them.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems design: event-driven architecture, service boundaries, data consistency, and failure modes.

  • You care about correctness and data integrity as much as velocity - you've worked in environments where getting it wrong has real consequences for real people.

  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in an environment where the spec is never fully finished and the team is still being built.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience building credit decisioning, risk scoring, or loan management systems.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up where you helped establish engineering foundations from scratch.

  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints specific to consumer credit (e.g. FCA, data protection requirements for credit data).


Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Ledger Platform
description:
Senior Back-End Engineer - Ledger Platform

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Back-End Engineer

This role is a chance to tackle complex, high-impact challenges at the heart of our fintech platform. You will join the team that owns iwoca's ledger — the system of record for the money we lend and collect — and you will be responsible for scaling it across the full lifecycle of our credit card and lending products, building the reconciliation and reporting that prove it correct, and laying the foundations for our next generation of products. This is a hands-on role: you'll design these systems, write the code, and own them in production.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Ledger Platform team owns the ledger across all of iwoca's products, from credit cards to our lending range, plus everything around it: reconciliation, financial reporting, and the data Finance, Accounting and Capital Markets run on. We work closely with a Product Manager, shipping frequently and owning our systems in production. Some of the team work fully remotely and others are hybrid, working 1-3 days per week in the London office.


The role

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Lead the delivery of projects involving many stakeholders and systems.

  • Go beyond the code to develop deep expertise in our domain — our core financial products and our stakeholders' needs — and become a trusted technical advisor to the business.

  • Perform detailed technical scoping and prototyping to support feasibility testing and decision making.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Architect and implement scalable solutions for complex challenges: the lifecycle of an account, interest and repayment allocation, reconciliation, and how financial data reaches our reporting stack.

  • Use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem, and structure software so that it is easy to understand, test and evolve.

  • Be pragmatic about which parts of a problem actually need solving now. The hardest work here is deciding what not to build.

  • Build solutions that avoid single points of failure, and make sure our releases happen with zero downtime.

  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, actionable technical plans that guide the team's work.

  • Promptly investigate and fix live issues, and ensure they do not resurface. Own what you ship in production and keep it reliable and easy to operate.

  • Contribute high-quality, production-ready code and foster a collaborative environment by reviewing work and writing useful documentation.

Learning and Growth:

  • Work with the team to improve our development and agile practices and raise our engineering standards.

  • Share new approaches and tooling with the wider engineering group through our internal forums and company-wide talks.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Extensive back-end engineering experience.

  • Experience building and running microservices and distributed systems in production. Comfortable reasoning about durable cross-service communication, transactional correctness, and failure modes at scale.

  • Extensive experience with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, but open to MySQL or similar (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle); emphasis is on data integrity.

  • Experience with systems where correctness is a hard requirement — ledgers, accounting, billing or payments, ideally in a regulated setting — including the invariants, immutable audit trails and reconciliation controls that enforce it.

  • Experience leading a feature or project end to end — scoping, design, delivery, and running it in production.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow - whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • A strong technical or mathematical foundation, evidenced by a degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Maths or similar) or equivalent professional experience.

  • You work well as a peer: pairing on hard problems, giving useful code review, and unblocking teammates day-to-day.

  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a technical trade-off to Finance, and a business constraint back to engineers.

Bonus:

  • A background in high-logic or high-scale fields like Fintech, Gaming, Healthcare Tech, Logistics, Security/Cryptography or similar.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

  • Knowledge of messaging frameworks and event-driven patterns (e.g. Kafka).

The salary

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role:

As our Account Management team grows we are looking for a customer-oriented and result-driven Enterprise AM to join us.

As an Enterprise Account Manager you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts.

In this role you will be responsible for a portfolio of top accounts. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll-up your sleeves and work hard.


What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of Tier 1 customers, building trusted relationships with champions, key decision makers, and executive stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Travel, HR, IT, and Leadership.

  • Build and execute strategic account plans by developing a deep understanding of your customers' business, identifying expansion opportunities, mitigating risks, and maximising long-term customer value.

  • Identify growth opportunities across business units, geographies, and product lines to expand your portfolio through new business opportunities, upselling, and cross-selling.

  • Drive adoption across Perk's Travel and Spend platform by identifying underutilised features, expanding use cases, and partnering with customers on change management initiatives.

  • Leverage data and analytics to lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), delivering reports and presentations that demonstrate business outcomes, product adoption, ROI, and future strategic opportunities to senior stakeholders.

  • Be an expert across Perk's Travel and Spend platform to educate customers on new capabilities and consistently meet or exceed quarterly expansion targets.

  • Identify common challenges within each account, develop timely solutions, and implement long-term strategies that improve customer outcomes and satisfaction.

  • Be Perk's biggest advocate within your customers and your customers' biggest advocate within Perk by partnering with Product, Engineering, and Technical Support teams to resolve issues, influence product improvements, and represent the voice of the customer.

  • Effectively prioritise your time and resources to maximise impact across your portfolio and key business initiatives.


What We're Looking For

  • Proven ability to build relationships across Finance, Procurement, Travel, HR, IT, and executive leadership within large enterprise organisations.

  • Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and long-term customer value.

  • Excellent prioritisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across a portfolio of strategic accounts.

 

On top of that, you will only be the right candidate if you are:

  • Experience using inside sales tools like Salesforce, Google Tools, Zendesk, Looker.


What We Offer

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.

What You'll Do:

Carry your own number. You'll hit your own pipeline targets as an active ADR. Your activity and results set the standard for everyone watching. You'll contribute to weekly forecasting alongside the Senior Manager.

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. You'll help build individual development plans grounded in a real read of each rep's attitude, process, and results, and you'll flag underperformance early, with context, instead of letting it fester.

Coach and upskill the team. You'll support team coaching sessions: live dialling, pitch practice, feedback loops. You'll run or contribute to upskilling initiatives, on your own or with Enablement. You'll share what's working, best practices, sequences, outbound approaches, with the wider team, and give direct, specific feedback often, recognizing strong work and not letting bad habits slide.

Sharpen process and tooling. You'll help spot where the team's workflows and tooling could run more efficiently, and support the Senior Manager in rolling out improvements without stripping reps of their autonomy. You'll be the go-to person for best practice on Salesforce, Outreach, and the team's automation tools.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.

What You'll Bring:

  • Hands-on ADR or SDR experience. You know what this job feels like from the inside, not just what it looks like from a deck.

  • A real coach's instinct. You get energy from making other people better, not just from hitting your own number.

  • The ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball. Your own quota, coaching newer reps, and process work will all pull on your time in the same week, and you know how to decide what actually matters right now.

  • Strong time management. This is one we screen for directly, not something we assume comes with experience.

  • A bias for building. You spot what needs fixing and go build it, rather than working only through a list of tasks someone else handed you.

  • Analytical rigor. You make calls based on data, not gut feel, and you're comfortable being specific about why a number moved, including when that number is going the wrong way.

  • You touch the line. Your metrics back it up: leading indicators (activity, sequence execution, pipeline hygiene) and lagging indicators (quota attainment, pipeline generated) that show a track record of real discipline, not one good quarter.

  • Real trust with your AE and RD partners, earned through consistency, not just alignment on paper.

  • Transparency, especially with leadership, especially when something isn't on track. We'd rather hear it early than find out later.

  • The kind of presence the team actually looks up to, not just reports to.

  • Comfort in an allbound model with a heavy outbound emphasis.

  • Self-awareness and a genuine investment in growing as a leader.

  • Language skills relevant to the UK, Benelux, or Nordics are a bonus, not a requirement.

We'll consider strong internal and external candidates. For external hires, the bar is high: we're looking for someone who brings something genuinely differentiated.

Culture and Values:

The EMEA SDR team are weather makers. We don't wait for opportunity, we create it. We're accountable, relentless, and we invest in each other like no other team does.

  • Relentless. Energy and intention every day. Every challenge is a chance to get stronger.

  • Character. Good humans first. Integrity, humility, and keeping our word.

  • Together. No one gets left behind. Differences make us better, not harder to manage.

  • Truth. Radical honesty. We say the hard things with care. That's how we move fast.

  • Accountable. We own our results, bias toward action, and don't wait to be told.

  • Pioneering. We take up space, experiment, and bring creative thinking to every challenge.

In NEMEA specifically, we operate in mature markets. We don't manufacture urgency, we earn entry by knowing the landscape better than the prospect does. We're pipeline gardeners: patient, precise, persistent.

"We don't book meetings. We build pipeline."

This role is a genuine development opportunity. For the right person, it's the foundation of a leadership career at Kong.

title: Data Scientist - Product Analytics
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

  • Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

  • Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

  • Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.

  • Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.

  • Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.

  • Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

  • React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.

  • A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.

  • Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.

  • A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.

  • A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.

  • A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.


If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.


Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer - Jobexit
description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
  • Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
  • Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
  • Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
  • Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).

 


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

  • Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing

  • Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after
  • Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up
  • Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels
  • Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce
  • Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region

title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

Join us as an Android Engineer and help us build the mobile experience that 600,000+ European businesses rely on every day to manage their finances. title: Quantum Information Scientist - Architecture & Performance
description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

About this position:

You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

Requirements

What you'll do:

As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

  • Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
  • Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
  • Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
  • Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
  • Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
  • Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
  • Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 

You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
-

How you'll grow:

During your first 3–6 months 
Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

Within 1 year 
Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. 

Longer term 
Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap.

--

What we're looking for:
We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack.

Must-have 

  • PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. 
  • Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. 
  • Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. 
  • Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. 
  • Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. 
  • Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems.
  • Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise.
  • Professional English. 

Important, but you can grow here 

  • Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. 
  • Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. 
  • Noise modelling. 
  • Resource and computational-cost analysis. 
  • Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. 

Bonus 

  • Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. 
  • Photonic quantum computing. 
  • Resource estimation. 
  • Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. 
  • Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. 

You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy.

Benefits

Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. 

  • Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. 
  • Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. 
  • Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. 
  • Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. 

Plus: 

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. 
  • Company savings plan.
  • 100% health coverage through Alan. 
  • Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
  • Swile meal vouchers. 
  • Access to Gymlib. 

Process 

  • Talent Acquisition interview, 30–45 min
  • Interview with Quantum Information hiring manager, 30-45 min
  • Presentation of previous research work and discussion with members of the theory team 
  • Reference checks 
  • Technical discussion based on a scientific paper or research topic
  • Offer 

For the technical exercise, you may be asked to explore scientific material outside your direct area of expertise and discuss how you would connect it to a broader architecture problem.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

title: Sales Enablement Manager - France
description:
À propos de Lexroom

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va la former, l'accompagner et la faire monter en compétence à travers la Lexroom Sales Academy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ?

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer.

  • Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne formez pas des commerciaux à vendre un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue.

  • Un impact direct : la qualité de l'équipe commerciale française dépendra de ce que vous construisez.

Vos responsabilités

  • Piloter la Lexroom Sales Academy en France : concevoir et animer des programmes de formation récurrents (onboarding, ramp-up, formation avancée), avec objectifs, contenus, calendrier et indicateurs de succès.

  • Gérer l'onboarding des nouvelles recrues commerciales : première semaine et deux premiers mois de ramp-up, en coordonnant agendas, supports, intervenants internes et exercices pratiques.

  • Animer vous-même les modules de formation : méthodologie de vente, discovery, démos, traitement des objections, négociation, gestion du pipeline, avec role-plays, coaching sur les appels et feedback structuré.

  • Maintenir les contenus à jour : playbooks, scripts, templates et supports de l'Academy, en phase avec l'évolution du produit, du marché et des performances de l'équipe. Transformer les succès internes (appels, emails, séquences, deals complexes) en ressources de formation réutilisables.

  • Travailler main dans la main avec les Sales Managers et les AE pour que la formation se traduise concrètement dans le pipeline, les appels et les démos.

  • Aligner l'Academy France avec les initiatives globales et adapter au marché français les best practices déjà éprouvées en Italie.

Profil recherché

  • Expérience en management commercial, sales enablement ou gestion de projet en environnement B2B (idéalement SaaS, tech ou conseil).

  • Solide mindset PMO : capacité à transformer des besoins en plans structurés, aligner les parties prenantes, tenir les délais, livrer et mesurer l'impact.

  • À l'aise aussi bien en animation (formations, ateliers, role-plays) que dans le travail de détail sur les process, les contenus et les métriques.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration transverse.

  • Très opérationnel : vous ne vous contentez pas de concevoir des programmes, vous participez aux appels, analysez les chiffres et itérez vite.

  • Français natif, anglais courant (équipes internes internationales).

  • Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable.

title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

Day One: Hands-On Frontline Support

  • Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

  • Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

  • NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process

  • Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

Notre société

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais qui rend la puissance de calcul IA accessible, abordable et disponible en quelques minutes. Grâce à notre propre infrastructure composée de centaines de GPU, startups, chercheurs et entreprises déploient leurs modèles d’IA sans se battre avec la technique.

Nous créons ce poste pour la rendre robuste face aux pics de charge, développer les API qui la font tourner et installer les bonnes pratiques qui permettront à l’équipe de grandir. Votre temps se partage à 80 % sur le back-end et 20 % sur le front-end.

 

Vos missions

• Tenir les pics de charge : une architecture qui absorbe le trafic sans ralentir.

• Développer nos API en Node.js : performantes, sécurisées, documentées.

• Installer les bonnes pratiques : revues de code, tests automatisés, monitoring.

• Optimiser la base de données PostgreSQL.

• Faire évoluer l’interface de la console en React.js (environ 20 % du temps).

 

Vos 6 premiers mois

1er mois : Prise en main de la console et de son architecture, premier audit de performance, premières mises en production.

3 mois : Tests de charge en place, premiers points de blocage corrigés, bonnes pratiques formalisées.

6 mois : Console capable d’absorber n'importe quelle montée en charge, monitoring et alertes opérationnels.

 

Votre expérience

• 5 ans ou plus en développement, avec une dominante back-end.

• Une expérience sur une plateforme grand public ou à fort trafic.

Vos expertises

• Node.js : conception d’API robustes et performantes.

• React.js : à l’aise pour faire évoluer une interface existante.

• Montée en charge : cache, files d’attente, tests de charge, scalabilité.

Un vrai plus :

Playwright, Grafana, connaissance du cloud ou des infrastructures GPU.

Votre façon de travailler : rigoureux sur la qualité, pragmatique, à l’aise pour partager vos pratiques avec l’équipe.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

• Un vrai défi technique : S'assurer de la robuste de la plateforme lors des montées en charge

• Un impact direct : Vos choix d’architecture façonnent la plateforme.

• Des standards à poser : c’est vous qui fixez le niveau d’exigence de l’équipe.

• Au cœur de l’IA : vos API pilotent une infrastructure GPU dédiée à l’IA.

 

Package et avantages

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

title: Senior Web Compatibility Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online.
